description: This PHP source file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Templatelexer, which implements the lexical analysis (lexer) component for processing Smarty template files. It contains token definitions, patterns, state management, and lexing logic specialized for Smarty template syntax.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Templatelexer
classes.description: Class responsible for lexing Smarty template source code into tokens for parsing, with specific handling for Smarty syntax components such as tags, literals, and strings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the lexer with source data and compiler context, sets up regex patterns for tokenization.

methods.name: PrintTrace
methods.description: Opens the lexer/parser trace file for debugging output.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in patterns with runtime delimiter regex, using compiler method.

methods.name: isAutoLiteral
methods.description: Determines if the current token represents an autoliteral left delimiter based on Smarty settings.

methods.name: yylex
methods.description: Dispatches lexing to the current state-specific tokenization method.

methods.name: yypushstate
methods.description: Pushes a new lexing state onto the stack, useful for nested or context-specific lexing.

methods.name: yypopstate
methods.description: Reverts to previous lexing state from the stack.

methods.name: yybegin
methods.description: Sets the current lexing state directly.

methods.name: yylex1
methods.description: Lexes tokens for the TEXT state, handling plain text, comments, and PHP code blocks.

methods.name: yy_r1_1
methods.description: Sets token as plain text in TEXT state.

methods.name: yy_r1_2
methods.description: Handles comment closing tags in TEXT state.

methods.name: yy_r1_4
methods.description: Processes PHP code tokens within Smarty templates.

methods.name: yy_r1_8
methods.description: Sets token as plain text for specific patterns.

methods.name: yy_r1_10
methods.description: Handles the start of a literal block in TEXT state.

methods.name: yy_r1_12
methods.description: Handles the end of a literal block in TEXT state.

methods.name: yy_r1_14
methods.description: Pushes into TAG state when a tag opening is detected.

methods.name: yy_r1_16
methods.description: Processes PHP code inside the lexer in the PHP section.

methods.name: yy_r1_19
methods.description: Handles text within XML and PHP blocks.

methods.name: yy_r2_1
methods.description: Handles the start of an 'if' or 'elseif' block inside a Smarty tag.

methods.name: yy_r2_4
methods.description: Handles 'for' loop start inside a Smarty tag.

methods.name: yy_r2_6
methods.description: Handles 'foreach' start inside a Smarty tag.

methods.name: yy_r2_8
methods.description: Handles 'set filter' directive inside a Smarty tag.

methods.name: yy_r2_10
methods.description: Handles 'makenocache' directive inside a Smarty tag.

methods.name: yy_r2_12
methods.description: Handles closing of a Smarty tag and pops the lexer state.

methods.name: yy_r2_15
methods.description: Handles 'child' or 'parent' Smarty block and pops the state.

methods.name: yy_r2_18
methods.description: Handles closing a Smarty block tag.

methods.name: yy_r2_20
methods.description: Handles the output tag or '{{' in Smarty syntax.

methods.name: yy_r2_23
methods.description: Handles the closing slash in tags.

methods.name: yy_r2_25
methods.description: Handles opening of a Smarty tag.

methods.name: yy_r3_*
methods.description: Handles various tokens inside the tag context, such as quotes, identifiers, operators, delimiters, and keywords.

methods.name: yy_r4_*
methods.description: Handles literal content with the ability to enter and exit literal modes.

methods.name: yy_r5_*
methods.description: Handles quoted strings, backtick strings, expressions, and nested tags within Smarty tags.
